## vaporize (vaporise vaporised vaporized revaporization revapourisation revaporize revaporise unvaporized unvaporised vaporizable vaporisable vaporization vaporisation vaporizer vaporiser):
## "Vapor" is spelled "Vapour" unless the word is "vaporize".  This
## seams odd to be, but I could not find any evidence that "vapourize"
## or "vapourise" is a legal word, although I could find some evidence
## it was used.  Nevertheless since "vapourize/-ise" doesn't seam to
## be a valid word, this spelling was not included.
